The real ShowroomInfo and BookingForm components are mounted below the cinema as the Details region and are untouched; beats 1 and 2 are the doors into them, which is why their CTAs are in-page anchors. #showroom is load bearing: the home door's Visit the showroom CTA points at it.

beats.headline: Contact and showroom
beats.body: Walk in any day of the week, or send an inquiry and we will come back to you.

beats.headline: Where to find us
beats.body: No appointment needed. Telling us you are coming means the model you want is set up and powered when you arrive.

facts.label: Showroom
facts.value: 610 C. Raymundo Avenue, Maybunga, Pasig City

facts.label: Open
facts.value: Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 8 PM

beats.headline: Tell us what the room needs
beats.body: The unit you are looking at, the size of the operatory, and when you want it in place. A free ocular visit comes first, so the unit fits the room.

beats.headline: We deliver, and we install what we deliver
beats.body: Clinics on Luzon are served by our own van and installation team. Units bound for the Visayas and Mindanao go by freight, with installation arranged on arrival.

beats.headline: Come and sit in the chair
beats.body: The showroom floor is the shortest way to decide. Everything on it is powered, and someone who knows the units is on the floor with you.
